title: specapp-graph/1
description: One composed document as parts, links and groups. Produced by specapp's reader of parts-links/1 documents, or by the pack's tool (`graph <document>`).

document.description: The path of the document relative to the pack.

name.description: The value of the key the class names, else the file's stem.

kind.description: The part's field `kind`, when it is one text.

fields.description: Every field but `block`, a marked place read as its value.

inside.description: The part it sits in (contain: in).

per.description: The part it exists once per instance of (contain: per).

id.description: `<from>-><to>:<carries>`, `?` for a missing end or name; the n-th repeat of the same text has `#<n>` appended.

fields.description: Every key but from, to and carries, a marked place read as its value.

added_by.description: The default of the pack that added the link.

border.description: The names the document's border lists, as written.

markers.description: Marked places outside the parts and links.

marker.description: A place a search may change, written {value, vary} in the document. The path is relative to its part or link, or to the document for a marker of the graph: keys joined with `.`, list positions as numbers.
